description: Remove a single plain environment variable from an app and roll it out. The pair to set_app_variable; setting a variable to an empty string is not the same thing to most apps. Variables Dockhold sets itself (PORT, DATABASE_URL, DATA_DIR and the app's address) cannot be removed. For a secret, call unset_app_secret instead.

app_id.description: The app id returned by list_apps

key.description: The environment variable name to remove

name: unset_app_variable
title: Remove an app variable
